Farm_bot.changelog:
Changes in Farm bot:
- Discord alerts for Hell events, rallies, and Fortress War (rally cooldown 1 min, FW cooldown 3 hours)
- Guild rally alerts ignore targets on Fort / Citadel / Capital
- Equip: handles the window closing itself after gear select(low fps bag)

Universal.changelog:
Changes in Universal bot:
- Guild rally alerts ignore targets on Fort / Citadel / Capital (OCR filter)
- Discord rally alert cooldown increased from 30 seconds to 1 minute
- Fast equip: handles the window closing itself after gear select(low fps bag)

Hunt.changelog:
Changes in Hunt:
- Optimization of the UI and internal logic, simplification of settings, faster initialization, and improvements to notifications and stability.
- Reduced CPU load
